title: Mitosis core rebuild: complete the SPEC implementation

completion_criteria.text: Preconditions 0, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 and 5 of decision 0116's eight-entry landing order are each either proven discharged by measurement, or their residual is named and then landed, or explicitly deferred by a recorded decision stating why step 6 may proceed without it. No precondition is assumed discharged.

MSP-1 through MSP-13 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md are each shipped and merged to main, or explicitly retired by a recorded decision naming the reason. MSP-0 already shipped as PR #15 (12053dc) and is not re-done.

The engine's declared phase set is exactly the collapsed eight - Probe, Decompose, Prep, Execute, Integrate, Ship, Resume, Remediate - and the phase-parity gate proves declared == phase() calls == opts.phase literals in both directions across all three surfaces.

SPEC success condition 1: a fix-typed spec ships end to end through the collapsed phase set, and its receipt is observed red on the base and green on the branch by a deterministic verb, never asserted by a model.

SPEC success condition 3: every Verified: line on a mitosis-opened pull request is composed from a journaled gate manifest entry carrying a recorded exit code; absent and BROKEN gates render as --not-verified with the reason.

MSP-1's budget gate holds a captured baseline for one real current-engine run, and a post-collapse run is measured against section 6's 3-fixed-plus-9-per-MSP budget, making decision 0115's three falsifiers payable rather than unmeasured.

The SPEC document itself is re-grounded and committed: every line citation in sections 4, 5, 12 and 14 re-verified against the then-current mitosis.js, each stale anchor corrected, and every validity gap found in the audit closed by a recorded decision.

spine.active_goal: Finish implementing docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md - step 6 of decision 0116's eight-entry landing order: fix pipeline, phase collapse, gate model. MSP-0 shipped as PR #15 (12053dc); MSP-1 through MSP-13 are unstarted. Steps 0-5 are its hard preconditions, have NO spec of their own, and their completion is UNPROVEN - auditing them to completion is inside this thread's scope, not an assumption it inherits.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN A FRESH SESSION. Do NOT implement first. Follow the dispatch brief in this thread's first session log: (A) audit preconditions 0, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5 - one agent per step, parallel, adversarially verified - plus the SPEC re-grounding; (B) research a remedy per gap; (C) land the prerequisite work and re-baselined SPEC, a decision recorded per call; (D) only then implement MSP-1..MSP-13 via a DEDICATED small dynamic Workflow, stacked PRs permitted.

open_risks.text: Steps 0-5 of the 0116 landing order have NO spec and no written acceptance criteria. They exist only as decision records 0107, 0108, 0109, 0112, 0113 and 0116. Derive each step's acceptance FROM its decision; where the decision defines none, say so rather than invent one.

A false 'discharged' verdict on a precondition is the most expensive error available here: SPEC section 2 states step 6 has no fallback for an absent precondition. Every step reported done must be refuted by a second agent before it is believed.

Work that plausibly discharges steps 0-5 landed under DIFFERENT numbering: quiescent-advance M0-M8, run-readiness-repair MSP-0..MSP-10, two-track-invariant-plan, b6-harness-liveness. Mapping that work onto step numbers is a required audit output. These are leads, not findings.
SPEC sections 4, 5, 12 and 14 were verified on 2026-07-30 against mitosis.js at 4,851 lines. That file is 5,514 lines at da0cefd. Treat EVERY line anchor as stale until re-derived by measurement.

The SPEC is NOT on main. Its only committed copy is branch docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec at d444797; the user ruled leaving it without a PR is fine. Decide in phase C whether to land it on main so CI, gates and subagents can read it.

Section 2's precondition table is dated 2026-07-30 and has moved since: worktree reaping ran, and durable run identity, quiescent exit, the build-ahead cap and the ci-to-green loop all shipped. Re-derive status by measurement; never inherit the table.

Section 2's human precondition is LIVE: a guard hook holds every Edit and Write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} for human approval. Every MSP writes there, so unattended fan-out stalls. Plan for interactive approval per write.

MSP-12's falsifier must be tested EARLY, not at the capstone. A 2026-07-30 audit measured that phases share state by LEXICAL CLOSURE (mspById, resumeMap, shipped/parked arrays, compensationStack, the mergeQueue chain). A stage needing that closure refutes pipeline-as-data.

The twinning tax (step 2) may still be live: an engine edit lands twice, byte-identically, across the MIRROR_CENSUS twin surface. Re-derive the twin set per MSP from MIRROR_CENSUS - every hand-written twin list so far was measured incomplete.

pr-create BLOCKS when a body value carries a literal merge command or REST merge-endpoint string as prose; the gate cannot tell describing from running. Rephrase any PR prose that names merge tooling.
Never compare raw suite totals: a gitignored hooks test adds about 9 to local counts. Reconcile per file. A prior session raised a false regression alarm on exactly this.

Five pre-existing dirty paths must stay uncommitted: .claude/settings.json, .zshrc, engine-args.mjs.bak-pre-promptsfix-043a2526, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/, .claude/workflows/mitosis.js.bak-pre-promptsfix-043a2526. Stage explicit paths only, never git add -A.
The .bak snapshot in the working tree carries the PRE-MSP-0 phase set (Final review, Shepherd). It is inert and older than main. Never read it as the current engine or as a target state.

key_decisions.title: The seven completion criteria are compressed to fit the 200-char cap, meaning preserved, none struck

out_of_scope: The feat pipeline - 0110 and 0118 sequence it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary. Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118 (limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary).
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for fix specifically. An off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - 0108. A webhook, daemon or server for the relaunch trigger - 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116 and 0120. Edges stay LSP-grounded; in-engine overlap survives as a pruning input only, never as the oracle.

Cluster-aware scheduling, and the journal's 2000-character paging through model output - fenced out by SPEC section 1 and deferred in section 13. Adding any new phase, work type or scheduler - section 1 forbids it.

Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117. Mitosis deploys its own gates and authors one receipt inside an EXISTING runner; an unmet floor halts fail-closed and names verify-setup.
Re-doing MSP-0. It shipped as PR #15 (12053dc): Final review deleted, Shepherd renamed to Resume, phase-parity gate live. Verify it still holds; do not re-implement it.

Other specs are consulted ONLY as evidence for the steps 0-5 precondition audit. Implementing their unshipped work is out of scope: run-readiness-repair MSP-0..MSP-10, the two-track invariant plan, b6-harness-liveness, quiescent-advance M0-M8 (already delivered).
The predecessor thread's two open follow-ups belong to it, not here: hardening .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh, and the settings deny drift per decision 0227.
